maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). ToeBoard_Outer: length +4 mm (end faces 2 mm proud of platform ends) and moved 2 mm outward in z; ToeBoard_Front / ToeBoard_Back: width +4 mm in z and moved 2 mm outward in x, so faces no longer share planes with SamsonPlatform; ReducerBearingHub_L: moved 2 mm outward in z, off the BeltGuard back plane; BorderTimber_Front/Back/Left/Right: each 4 mm longer so ends stand 2 mm proud of GravelPad ends; MotorCradle: height 0.12 -> 0.116 keeping bottom fixed, so MotorFin_5 stands 4 mm proud of its top; SkidRunner_TFlange_L/R: thickness 0.025 -> 0.021 keeping bottom fixed, off the counterweight plane; CounterWeight_Main_L/R: thickness 0.22 -> 0.224 so faces stand 2 mm off the TFlange edge planes
